name: config-tune
prompt: In settings.json, change the value of "log_level" from "info" to "debug". Do not change anything else: every other byte of the file (whitespace, key order, formatting) must remain identical.
verify: python3 -c "import json; orig=open('.settings.orig').read(); cur=open('settings.json').read(); assert cur != orig, 'file unchanged'; assert json.loads(cur)['log_level'] == 'debug'; assert cur == orig.replace(': \"info\"', ': \"debug\"'), 'bytes other than log_level changed'"
